source.title: 50 Design Styles Every Designer Should Know for Better Prompting
source.author: Himanshu Bhardwaj
source.boards: A style's example board is a strip of examples by other designers; examples are reference only, never reused.
source.credit: Himanshu Bhardwaj (UX Planet); posters by various designers

families.classical-ornament: Historic decorative traditions: symmetry, frames, serif or blackletter type, metallic accents.
families.fine-art: Painting and illustration techniques used as a whole-image treatment.
families.calm-minimal: Quiet, natural, low-contrast styles with lots of space.
families.retro-digital: Nostalgia for past computer, game and internet eras.
families.structural-modern: Grid, geometry and type-led modernist styles.
families.interface: Screen-native surface styles for product UI.
families.cozy-handmade: Soft, sentimental, crafted or cute styles.
families.playful-graphic: Characters, puns, irony and street energy.
families.themed-worlds: Genre settings with their own props, palette and type.
families.type-led: Styles carried by the lettering itself: wordmarks, display type and type-first layouts.
families.rendered-3d: CGI looks: clay, glass, chrome, dioramas and other rendered materials.

styles.name: Neoclassical
styles.cues: Greek and Roman statues and columns, marble, laurel, strict symmetry, high-contrast serif or condensed display caps, muted stone palette with one deep accent
styles.use: luxury, museums, heritage, academic, editorial
styles.board: Four posters: a palace facade with statues under script type, a black-and-white archangel statue under tall condensed 'PANTHEON' caps, a marble bust over a deep red ground, an etched arch with ornate 'Renaissance' lettering.
styles.recipe: Classical marble statue or column as the hero, photographed or etched in greyscale, centred on a strict symmetrical axis; tall condensed serif or display caps across the top; stone, black and off-white with one deep accent (oxblood or navy); small technical captions in the corners; subtle paper or stone grain.

styles.name: Baroque
styles.cues: scrolling acanthus flourishes, heavy ornamental frames, gold leaf on black, engraved texture, dramatic contrast
styles.use: invitations, premium packaging, book covers, lavish editorial
styles.board: Four pieces: a blue-and-white ornate cartouche wedding invite, a gold-on-black engraved torch framed by flourishes, a bronze book cover with mountain etching inside a scroll frame, a sepia engraved crest card.
styles.recipe: Dense scrolling Baroque ornament framing a central emblem or title; gold or bronze line engraving on near-black, or cobalt on white for a porcelain variant; deep shadows and high contrast; classical serif title in caps inside the frame; every edge filled with symmetrical flourishes.

styles.name: Aurora
styles.cues: iridescent flowing gradients, glow, blur, soft light rays, dark or deep blue grounds, thin modern sans
styles.use: tech launches, wellness apps, event posters, ambient backgrounds
styles.board: Four posters: a blue receding portal gateway, green northern lights over a dark forest, a black ground with a blue-violet liquid gradient wave and thin 'EXHIBITION' type, a blue light-tunnel road with a tiny figure.
styles.recipe: Deep navy or black field with one flowing iridescent gradient band (teal, blue, violet, magenta) blurred like northern lights or liquid light; soft glow and bloom; one small focal element or figure for scale; thin light sans-serif type with generous tracking; no hard edges.

styles.name: Ethereal
styles.cues: motion blur, soft focus, haze, low contrast, faded pastel or misty tones, delicate serif or script type
styles.use: fashion, spiritual brands, music, mindfulness
styles.board: Four photo posters: a blurred red figure on misty teal with mixed serif-script type, a soft-focus woman in a blurred crowd, red long-exposure light streaks on a night street, a hazy railway with bold red sans type.
styles.recipe: Photograph with long-exposure motion blur and soft focus, so figures dissolve into haze; low contrast, lifted blacks, misty teal or pale grey grounds with one warm colour; light grain; delicate serif mixed with an elegant script, set small with lots of air around it.

styles.name: Filigree
styles.cues: fine metallic linework, lace-like ornament, frames and borders, gold on black or navy, monogram and decorative serif type
styles.use: book covers, invitations, heritage packaging, labels
styles.board: Four pieces: an ornate gold-on-black event poster with decorative lettering, a silver-on-black book cover with a dagger and birds inside fine frames, a navy-and-gold fantasy book cover with thin line ornament.
styles.recipe: Hairline gold or silver ornamental linework forming a symmetrical frame of curls, arches and small emblems; black or deep navy ground; centred title in a decorative or engraved serif with flourished capitals; thin rules and tiny stars as fillers; foil-like metallic sheen.

styles.name: Acanthus
styles.cues: curling leaf motifs, William Morris-style botanical repeats, carved frames, sage, deep green, cream and muted gold
styles.use: wedding stationery, museums, premium products, wallpaper patterns
styles.board: Four pieces: a William Morris acanthus-and-flower print on navy, a carved gilt frame wedding invite, an engraved library bookplate with leaf ornament, a sage invitation framed in acanthus scrolls.
styles.recipe: Curling acanthus leaves and vines in symmetrical scrolls framing the content, or as a dense Arts and Crafts repeat pattern; sage, forest green, cream and muted gold on navy or parchment; engraved or block-printed texture; classical serif type in small caps.

styles.name: Anthropomorphic
styles.cues: animals or objects with human posture, clothes or faces, simple bold shapes, flat colour, playful scale
styles.use: mascots, kids products, gamified UX, approachable brands, event posters
styles.board: Four posters: a vintage ferret in a corset advert, flat black-and-white cartoon animals sitting on a real street photo, a blue dachshund beside a tulip chair on yellow, a pink cat with binoculars on a building.
styles.recipe: An animal or everyday object behaving like a person (posing, wearing clothes, using tools) as the single hero; flat graphic shapes with a confident outline or none; one or two bold background colours; optional cut-out character placed onto a real photo; short playful headline.

styles.name: Pixel Art
styles.cues: visible square pixels, limited 8- and 16-bit palettes, pixel fonts, dithering, sprite characters
styles.use: indie games, retro events, creative portfolios, stickers
styles.board: Four posters: a space-battle pixel scene with chunky yellow logo, a pixel park with trees and benches, a UFO over pixel forest with 'I WANT TO BELIEVE' in pixel type, a seaside train station with pixel clouds.
styles.recipe: Scene drawn on a hard pixel grid at 16-bit resolution with a limited palette (16 to 32 colours) and light dithering in skies; crisp nearest-neighbour edges, no anti-aliasing; chunky pixel display type; calm landscape or a single sprite character; no smooth gradients.

styles.name: Conceptual Sketch
styles.cues: loose black ink or marker line drawings, cream paper, one flat accent colour, hand-drawn lettering, lots of white space
styles.use: portfolios, menus, event flyers, brand illustration
styles.board: Four posters: a cool cat at a piano in thick hand lettering, a 'HOUSE PARTY' flyer with ink-line hands and green type, a minimal line-drawn table setting, a wall mural of a line-drawn woman with 'Software should be beautiful'.
styles.recipe: Loose single-weight black ink line drawing, unfilled, on warm cream paper; one flat accent colour for the headline (green, red or blue); bold grotesk or hand-drawn lettering; generous empty space; small handwritten details and simple ruled info boxes.

styles.name: Luxury Typography
styles.cues: high-contrast didone or script wordmark as the hero, wide letter spacing, monochrome or muted photo, gold, cream or navy
styles.use: fashion, beauty, hospitality, yachts, high-end editorial
styles.board: Four posters: a greyscale temple under a high-contrast 'PEACE' serif, a martini glass on green velvet under a flowing serif wordmark, a dim palace stairway with small luxe type, a navy sea and speedboat under a script 'yacht club' wordmark.
styles.recipe: One high-contrast didone or refined script wordmark carrying the whole layout, small and centred over a muted, moody photograph; tiny widely tracked sans captions; palette of black, cream, deep green or navy with a single gold note; vast negative space, nothing decorative.

styles.name: Japandi
styles.cues: warm beige and oat grounds, light wood, rounded arches and pebbles, flat food or object illustration, clean sans type
styles.use: lifestyle, interiors, wellness apps, food and tea brands
styles.board: Four posters: a flat ramen bowl on cream with thin type, an arched wood-panelled interior with 'SIMPLICITY', a kimchi bowl graphic with sage and muted red, a beige layout with arch-cropped ceramics and stacked pebble shapes.
styles.recipe: Warm oat or greige ground with soft rounded shapes (arches, pebbles, circles) in clay, sage and charcoal; one natural object (ceramic, wood, bowl of food) as a flat illustration or arch-cropped photo; clean sans or light serif type, small; asymmetric balance and generous space.

styles.name: Memphis
styles.cues: squiggles, terrazzo and dot patterns, clashing primaries and pastels, floating geometric solids, black outlines
styles.use: creative brands, event posters, retro fashion, kids
styles.board: Four posters: a Memphis design poster with triangles, squiggle and cheetah-dot borders, a red Mars rocket poster in flat geometry, 3D block letters on pink with confetti shapes, a 'Memphis in Memphis' poster with red and blue shapes on black.
styles.recipe: Collage of flat geometric solids (triangles, circles, zigzags, squiggles) with black-and-white terrazzo and dot patterns; clashing pink, mint, yellow, lavender and red; thick black outlines and offset shadows; chunky geometric display type; shapes floating at odd angles.

styles.name: Bohemian
styles.cues: organic cut-out leaves and suns, arches, earthy muted palette, groovy 70s type, paper texture
styles.use: handmade products, travel, wellness, art prints
styles.board: Four prints: arches and black palm leaves in clay and sage, a beige botanical leaf in a vase, green cut-paper plants with 'SUN SEEKER', a groovy 70s sunrise with wavy 'YOU ARE MY SUNSHINE'.
styles.recipe: Matisse-like cut-paper leaves, suns and arches in flat organic shapes; earthy palette of sage, sand, clay, mustard and black on cream; groovy rounded 70s display type or simple serif; slight paper texture; relaxed asymmetric layout. Swap any orange or terracotta for mustard, clay-pink or sage.

styles.name: Shabby Chic
styles.cues: faded watercolour florals, blush pink and powder blue, lace and antique glass, vintage serif and script
styles.use: weddings, perfume, vintage boutiques, home decor
styles.board: Four pieces: a pastel vintage magazine cover of a frilly bedroom, a soft watercolour flower print 'FLEURS', vintage perfume bottles with roses, a pastel flower pot with 'GOOD THINGS GROW'.
styles.recipe: Faded watercolour roses and peonies in blush pink, powder blue and cream; antique objects (perfume bottles, lamps, lace) softly painted; whitewashed, slightly distressed paper; vintage serif headline with a flowing script accent; airy centred layout.

styles.name: Farmhouse / Cottagecore
styles.cues: storybook cottages, gardens and flowers, vintage book illustration, aged paper, green and cream with floral colour, decorative serif
styles.use: lifestyle, recipes, rustic home brands, book covers
styles.board: Four vintage-style covers: 'The Cottage Gardens' with a white gate, a storybook cottage in flower fields with serif script, a framed cottage garden with 'A beautiful LIFE begins at HOME', an old German book cover of a girl at a garden gate.
styles.recipe: Vintage storybook illustration of a cottage, garden gate or flower meadow, gouache or lithograph look; aged cream paper with foxing; leafy green, sky blue, rose and buttercup; decorative old-style serif or hand-lettered title; framed vignette composition.

styles.name: Victorian
styles.cues: many mixed display typefaces, engraved illustrations, ornate borders and banners, sepia, deep red and green, almanac layouts
styles.use: book covers, tea and apothecary brands, period events
styles.board: Four pieces: a striped 'Victorian Christmas Party' bill with mixed type, an engraved medical almanac cover, a floral memorial card in an ornate frame, an antique soap advert in sepia.
styles.recipe: Playbill or almanac layout stacking six or more ornate display typefaces (slab, tuscan, script, outline) with ribbons and banners; engraved line illustration; sepia or cream paper with deep red, bottle green and gold; dense ornate border; aged and slightly worn print.

styles.name: Art Deco
styles.cues: gold geometric line frames, sunbursts, stepped arches, symmetry, navy or black with gold, tall geometric sans
styles.use: cocktail events, luxury brands, invitations, hotels
styles.board: Four posters: a hand holding a coupe glass on navy with gold line grid, Saturn between gold columns on black, a cream-and-gold wedding invitation in geometric frames, a navy bachelor-party invite with gold deco linework.
styles.recipe: Symmetrical gold hairline geometry (stepped arches, fan sunbursts, nested rectangles, chevrons) framing a centred title on deep navy, black or cream; tall high-waisted geometric sans or deco display type, widely tracked; one stylised hero object such as a coupe glass; metallic foil sheen.

styles.name: Art Nouveau
styles.cues: whiplash curves, floral arches framing a figure, flowing hair, muted olive, cream, rose and teal, hand-drawn rounded display type
styles.use: natural cosmetics, artisan packaging, theatre and art posters
styles.board: Four posters: a Jugendstil explainer with ornate frame, a hand holding a bottle in a floral arch, a woman in profile framed by flowers and an arch, a peach type specimen with 'Nouveau' lettering.
styles.recipe: Mucha-style portrait or product inside a rounded arch frame of flowing vines and flowers; whiplash curves throughout; muted olive, cream, dusty rose, teal and gold; flat colour with fine dark outlines; soft hand-drawn display type with curling terminals across the top.

styles.name: Mystical Western
styles.cues: tarot card frames, cowboys and skeletons, cacti, crescent moon and stars, desert under night sky, western serif
styles.use: tarot apps, crystal shops, music art, indie brands
styles.board: Four illustrations: a skeleton cowboy tarot card with cacti, a rider and rocket launch over a desert flower field, a cowboy in a desert canyon at sunrise, cacti and a crescent moon under stars.
styles.recipe: Tarot-card composition: a cowboy, skeleton rider or lone cactus under a crescent moon and scattered stars, inside a thin ornamental card frame with a numeral and title plate; vintage screenprint texture; dusty teal, sand, bone and deep night blue; western serif type. Keep accents to teal, gold and bone, never orange.

styles.name: Kitsch
styles.cues: maximal retro advertising, clashing saturated colours, film-star portraits, crammed badges and logos, mixed loud type
styles.use: parody, Gen Z fashion, club nights, nostalgic remixes
styles.board: Four posters: a maximal Indian superhero sticker collage, a retro actress holding chai under big pink type, a Bollywood night flyer with tigers and saturated red, a vintage candy advert.
styles.recipe: Maximalist retro-advert collage: a vintage film-star or product photo in the middle, surrounded by badges, stickers, starbursts and logos; saturated red, hot pink, yellow, teal and green clashing on purpose; several loud display typefaces with drop shadows; nothing left empty.

styles.name: Y2K
styles.cues: chrome and holographic gradients, early mobile phones and VR, lavender and blue skies, sparkles, tech-label typography
styles.use: fashion, music, tech revival, social posts
styles.board: Four posters: a holographic violet report with an early mobile phone, a chrome sports car with VR headset, a grass field with floating chrome pods and sneakers, a lavender cloud sky with sparkly script type and a barcode.
styles.recipe: Glossy chrome objects (early phones, headsets, cars) on holographic lavender, baby blue and silver gradients or a dreamy cloud sky; sparkle stars, lens flares, barcodes and tech labels; mix of wide techno sans and bubbly chrome lettering; slight digital grain.

styles.name: Bauhaus
styles.cues: circles, triangles and squares, red, yellow, blue and black on cream, diagonal bands, geometric sans, checkerboards
styles.use: architecture, product design, brand systems, event posters
styles.board: Four posters: a primary-coloured armchair on a blue checkerboard, a vertical race car built from blocks, diagonal stripes with stacked metro cars, a diagonal black band with 'BAUHAUS' and red circle.
styles.recipe: Composition of flat primary geometry (circle, square, triangle, diagonal bars) in red, yellow, blue and black on warm cream; strong diagonal or grid structure; bold geometric sans in black, set rotated or stacked; one object reduced to blocks; no gradients or texture.

styles.name: Brutalism
styles.cues: concrete tower blocks, halftone, two-colour print, raw grids, oversized cropped grotesk type, technical labels
styles.use: artist portfolios, music, experimental sites, counterculture brands
styles.board: Four posters: blue-on-cream halftone 'BEACON OF HOPE', a crane over a concrete tower with red 'BRUTALISM', a pink two-colour risograph of tower blocks, a red and black poster with a cropped concrete building.
styles.recipe: Concrete architecture photographed hard and printed as coarse halftone in one or two flat inks (red, cobalt or pink on off-white); huge condensed grotesk headline cropped off the edges; visible grid, rules, tiny technical labels and icons; raw, unpolished alignment.

styles.name: Cybercore
styles.cues: chrome and liquid metal, violet and blue neon on black, glitch, rave typography, tech UI fragments, barcodes
styles.use: tech events, raves, games, music releases
styles.board: Four posters: a blue blur drum-and-bass poster with liquid type, a spiky chrome sphere on violet for a club night, a chrome collage of devices and UI fragments, glossy chrome chains on black.
styles.recipe: Liquid chrome or glossy 3D metal objects (chains, spikes, blobs) lit in electric violet and blue on black; glitch streaks and motion smears; rave-style stretched or melted display type; tiny UI labels, barcodes and grid marks around the edges.

styles.name: Synthwave
styles.cues: 80s neon grid horizon, chrome script lettering, sunset with stripes, palm silhouettes, sports cars, magenta and cyan
styles.use: music visuals, arcade, nostalgia brands, event posters
styles.board: Four posters: chrome 'RETRO WAVE' over a neon car and grid, a chrome script over a striped sunset and palm, a neon '80s' lettering over a city and sports car, chrome keypad buttons pressed by a hand.
styles.recipe: 1980s retro-futurism: magenta-to-violet sky with a striped sun, cyan perspective grid floor, silhouetted palms or a neon-edged sports car; chrome beveled script or block lettering with lens flare; VHS scanlines and glow. Keep the sun magenta to violet rather than orange.

styles.name: Vaporwave
styles.cues: Greek busts, old OS windows and cursors, Japanese text, pink and teal gradients, palm trees, glitch
styles.use: indie music, zines, art projects, meme-aware brands
styles.board: Four posters: a pink bust with pixel sunglasses among old computer windows, a meditating statue in clouds with 'WHO CARES', a bust with shutter shades and Japanese text, a statue collage with IBM monitor and palms.
styles.recipe: Classical bust or statue collaged with 90s computer elements (dialog boxes, cursors, CRT monitors), palm trees and Japanese katakana; pink, cyan and violet gradients; checkered floors and grid; glitch and pixel effects; ironic slogan in wide or pixel type.

styles.name: Pop Art
styles.cues: comic outlines, halftone dots, flat saturated primaries, sunglasses and icons, collage of panels, bold display type
styles.use: campaigns, retail packaging, festivals, social
styles.board: Four posters: a crammed arts-camp poster with parrots and hot dogs, the Statue of Liberty in sunglasses with a cocktail, a retro Las Vegas sign scene, a comic-panel Malaysia independence day poster.
styles.recipe: Comic-book illustration with thick black outlines, flat saturated primaries (red, yellow, cobalt, teal, pink) and Ben-Day halftone dots; iconic subject with a cheeky twist (landmark in sunglasses); comic panels or crowded collage; bold chunky display type with drop shadows.

styles.name: Bento Box
styles.cues: rounded tile grid of mixed sizes, one idea per tile, product shots and icons, soft shadows, neutral or dark grounds
styles.use: landing pages, feature overviews, dashboards, portfolios
styles.board: Four boards: a green grocery brand in mixed tiles, a creator app feature grid with photos and bold type, a dark smart-home feature grid, a pastel messaging-app grid with phone mockups.
styles.recipe: Rounded-corner card grid of mixed tile sizes (one hero tile, several small) with 12 to 16 px gaps; each tile holds one feature: a product photo, one icon or a short bold headline; consistent radius, subtle shadow or none; neutral light or dark ground with one accent colour; clean grotesk type.

styles.name: Graffiti
styles.cues: spray-paint tags and throw-ups, drips, neon green or pink, bubble letters over gritty photos, street textures
styles.use: streetwear, sneakers, music festivals, youth campaigns
styles.board: Four posters: a spray-painted tag over a muscle car, pink bubble graffiti on hot pink, neon green tags over a red sports car, green bubble letters behind a sneaker shot.
styles.recipe: Hand-sprayed graffiti tag or puffy bubble letters with drips and outlines layered over a gritty street or car photo; one acid colour (neon green, hot pink) against muted photo tones; spray mist, concrete and sticker textures; small condensed captions. Avoid orange tags.

styles.name: Tenebrism
styles.cues: single hard light on a face or object, deep black surroundings, chiaroscuro, painterly or cinematic portraits, thin serif titles
styles.use: film posters, luxury ads, storytelling, book covers
styles.board: Four posters: a cinematic close-up of a man with a finger to his lips in darkness, a sportsman portrait with a watch on black, a product ad on black, a dark knight portrait with thin serif title.
styles.recipe: Subject lit by one hard side light emerging from near-total black, Caravaggio-style chiaroscuro; rich shadows that swallow the edges; desaturated warm skin tones or one product highlight; thin widely tracked serif or small caps title in the dark area; fine film grain.

styles.name: Gothic
styles.cues: blackletter type, cathedrals and spires, black with blood red or violet, engraved horror illustration, ornate dark frames
styles.use: fantasy books, metal and music posters, alternative fashion
styles.board: Four pieces: a pink-on-navy cathedral silhouette with blackletter 'Goth', a clawed hand under red blackletter 'Dracula', an engraved crowd scene for a band, a red ornamental frame on black with 'Vampires'.
styles.recipe: Blackletter title in blood red, bone or dusty violet on black; Gothic cathedral spires, a clawed hand or an engraved crowd scene as the image; ornate thorny border frames; woodcut or engraving texture; strict centred symmetry.

styles.name: Pointillism
styles.cues: stipple and dot shading, halftone grain, one or two ink colours, surreal or close-up subjects
styles.use: art prints, editorial, music, educational content
styles.board: Four posters: a stippled ice-cream cone on pink, a stippled film-poster collage, a black-and-white stippled smoke swirl with stars, stippled eyes on kraft paper.
styles.recipe: Image built entirely from stippled dots: dense where dark, sparse where light; one or two inks (black, plus pink or blue) on paper or kraft; a bold close-up subject (eyes, a dessert, swirling smoke); small grotesk caption type; visible paper texture.

styles.name: Mixed Media
styles.cues: cut-out photos with sketch lines, paint strokes and stickers, grid paper, vintage engravings, layered type
styles.use: magazines, fashion, social campaigns, experimental branding
styles.board: Four collages: a photo of a seated man with paint scribbles and type, a vintage gentleman with googly eyes on grid paper, a fashion cut-out with leaves and line doodles, a travel collage of landmarks and stamps.
styles.recipe: Collage of cut-out photographs (people, landmarks, objects) combined with hand-drawn scribbles, paint strokes, stickers and torn paper on a grid or newsprint ground; one or two bright accent colours; mix of a big editorial serif and handwritten notes; layered with drop shadows.

styles.name: Steampunk
styles.cues: brass gears, goggles, airships, Victorian engraving, sepia and bronze, ornate playbill type
styles.use: games, books, conventions, cosplay
styles.board: Four posters: a bronze plague-doctor mask with gears and lamp, a goggled aviator in an ornate frame, an engraved airship with Victorian type, a sepia airship regatta playbill.
styles.recipe: Victorian engraving of brass machinery, airships, goggles and clockwork; sepia, bronze, brass and deep brown on aged parchment; ornate Victorian playbill typography with banners; gears and pipes framing the edges; worn print texture.

styles.name: Kawaii
styles.cues: chubby smiling characters, stickers, pastel candy colours, bubbly rounded type, Japanese and Korean text, sparkles
styles.use: stationery, kids, snacks and drinks, events, social
styles.board: Four posters: a sticker-packed Korean study-club flyer with cute cats, a pink ramune bottle with bubbly 'PECHA DRINK', a pastel event info poster with cute characters, a festival poster with a smiling ramen bowl.
styles.recipe: Cute round characters with tiny faces and blush cheeks (animals, food, drinks) scattered like stickers; pastel pink, mint, butter yellow and sky blue with white outlines; bubbly rounded display type; sparkles, hearts and small info chips; busy but soft.

styles.name: Coquette
styles.cues: baby pink, bows and ribbons, cut-out glamour photos, retro phones, script and elegant serif, scrapbook stars
styles.use: beauty brands, fashion reels, pop music, lifestyle
styles.board: Four posters: a pink bow with a white cat and elegant type, a cut-out singer with script and stars, beauty products around a selfie with serif-script title, a pink rotary phone under bubbly pink script.
styles.recipe: Baby pink and cream palette with satin bows, pearls, hearts and small stars; cut-out glamour or product photos with soft shadows; mix of elegant italic serif and bubbly retro script; scrapbook layering on a white or pale pink ground; soft-focus vintage glow.

styles.name: Surrealism
styles.cues: impossible scale, objects in the wrong place, dreamlike photo composites, clean skies, deadpan realism
styles.use: concept art, ads, editorial covers, launches
styles.board: Four images: a giant jewellery box building among city towers, a cut-out woman on roller skates over huge red type, a magazine cover of helicopters lifting a skyscraper, giant sunglasses on a crowded beach.
styles.recipe: Photorealistic composite where one everyday object is placed at impossible scale or in the wrong context (giant sunglasses on a beach, a building inside a gift box); clean natural light so it reads as real; calm sky or plain ground; minimal type that lets the image carry the idea.

styles.name: Utilitarian
styles.cues: Swiss grid, black grotesk on white or grey, one functional accent colour, index numbers and data labels, product object
styles.use: manuals, signage, utility apps, tech product pages
styles.board: Four posters: a Swiss-grid city poster with yellow block and black grotesk, a workbook layout with numbered lists, a grey device poster with large numerals and a red bar, a TV-show poster with green cross and small credits.
styles.recipe: Strict Swiss grid on white or light grey; black neo-grotesk type in two sizes only, with index numbers, dates and small data labels; one functional accent (yellow, red or green) as a flat block or bar; a single product or object photographed plainly; zero decoration.

styles.name: Mid-Century
styles.cues: flat cut-paper shapes, abstract faces and organic forms, mustard, teal, black and cream, bold sans, 1950s optimism
styles.use: furniture, lifestyle, editorial, music posters
styles.board: Four posters: abstract curved shapes in blue, mustard and cream, a split black-and-pink face with 'DIFFERENT IS BEAUTIFUL', a cut-paper mouth for a samba night, an abstract face magazine cover.
styles.recipe: Flat cut-paper shapes (curves, half circles, boomerangs, stylised eyes and faces) in mustard, teal, cobalt, pink, black and cream; slight paper grain; bold geometric or condensed sans; playful abstract composition with lots of overlap. Replace the period's orange with mustard or coral-pink.

styles.name: Scrapbook
styles.cues: torn paper, tape, ransom-note letters, cut-out photos, stickers and doodles, notebook and cork textures
styles.use: events, school and college, journaling apps, social
styles.board: Four flyers: a graduation flyer with cut-out photos and tape, a college-night flyer in ransom-note letters on cork, a retro TV party flyer with stickers, a sticker-bomb concert poster with cartoon dinosaurs.
styles.recipe: Layered cut-out photos and stickers taped onto notebook, cork or grid paper; ransom-note headline made from mismatched cut letters; torn edges, washi tape, doodles and handwritten notes; bright mixed colours; slight drop shadows so every piece feels physical.

styles.name: Neo Frutiger Aero
styles.cues: glossy translucent bubbles and glass, bright sky blue and grass green, fish, plants and water, sunny clean 3D
styles.use: tech, playful fintech, wellness, spring campaigns
styles.board: Four posters: inflated glossy blue letters with goldfish and bubbles over a meadow, glass plants and spheres in a sunny field, a glass bowl of flowers on grass, a dreamy arch with cherubs and pink clouds.
styles.recipe: Bright sky-blue and grass-green world with glossy translucent 3D elements (bubbles, glass spheres, inflated letters, water droplets); fish, leaves and flowers; sunny lens flare; clean rounded humanist sans type; everything wet, shiny and optimistic.

styles.name: Dark Magic Academia
styles.cues: candlelit studies, castles and stormy skies, deep green, black and gold, old books, elegant serif titles
styles.use: fantasy games, book clubs, witchy brands, film posters
styles.board: Four posters: a moody green study full of curiosities with serif 'Dark Academia', a blue line-art castle under red lightning, a misty castle with a flying figure, a girl at a wardrobe door glowing with light.
styles.recipe: Candlelit library or study full of books, specimens and brass instruments, or a Gothic castle under a stormy sky; deep green, black, oxblood and antique gold; heavy shadows with warm pools of light; high-contrast elegant serif title; slight painterly or film grain.

styles.name: Light Academia
styles.cues: cream and parchment, Renaissance fresco crops, arches and ovals, thin elegant serif, small sparkles
styles.use: journals, study apps, museums, fashion, editorial
styles.board: Four posters: a fresco cropped into an hourglass shape with thin serif type, a Versailles ceiling fresco in an arched window, a gilded Renaissance frame on a text page, a torn fresco with a fine serif title.
styles.recipe: Warm cream or parchment ground; a Renaissance fresco or classical painting cropped into an arch, oval or hourglass window; thin high-contrast serif title widely tracked; tiny four-point sparkles and fine rules; quiet, airy, centred layout.

styles.name: Wabi Sabi
styles.cues: imperfect ceramics, plaster and sand textures, earthy neutrals, organic blobs, soft daylight, small thin type
styles.use: wellness, tea and ceramics, interiors, mindful apps
styles.board: Four pieces: a cracked mended ceramic with small editorial type, stacked organic blob shapes on cream, an aerial sand texture with a thin wordmark, a plaster-walled living room in soft light.
styles.recipe: Close crop of an imperfect handmade object (cracked ceramic, raw plaster, sand ripples) in soft natural daylight; earthy neutral palette of stone, oat, clay and charcoal; organic uneven shapes; tiny thin serif or light sans type far from the subject; lots of quiet space.

styles.name: South West / Wild West
styles.cues: desert mesas, cowboys and rodeo, wanted-poster slab serifs, sun-bleached sand and saddle brown, engraved spot illustrations
styles.use: outdoor gear, ranch brands, festivals, typefaces
styles.board: Four posters: a desert mesa landscape under big western slab type, a western display-type specimen with spot illustrations, a vintage rodeo poster with a bucking horse, a green-and-cream rodeo playbill with ornate western type.
styles.recipe: Wanted-poster layout with bold western slab and tuscan serif type; desert mesa or bucking-horse illustration in engraved or vintage poster style; sun-bleached sand, saddle brown, sage and faded denim blue on cream; worn print texture. Use saddle brown and sage instead of the genre's usual terracotta and orange.

styles.name: Nautical
styles.cues: navy line engraving, sailing ships, anchors, rope, lobsters and gulls, cream paper, vintage travel poster
styles.use: seafood, resorts, summer campaigns, sailing clubs
styles.board: Four posters: a navy engraved galleon with anchor and rope, a linocut mermaid in a ship's frame, a vintage travel poster with a lobster and lighthouse, a pencil sketch of a racing yacht with serif type.
styles.recipe: Navy or cobalt line engraving of a sailing ship, anchor, lobster or lighthouse on cream paper, framed by rope and banners; vintage travel-poster colour (sea blue, white, brick red) as an option; classic serif or stencil type; crisp linocut or engraving texture.

styles.name: Rebus
styles.cues: small inline images replacing or sitting between words, big black headline type, off-white ground, witty copy
styles.use: brand campaigns, billboards, social posts, education
styles.board: Four ads: a headline with tiny chicken and chilli images inline, a furniture headline with sofa and table images between words, a dense headline with stickers and product icons inline, a billboard sentence with a small photo inline.
styles.recipe: Large black sentence-case headline on an off-white ground with small cut-out images set inline at text height, replacing or illustrating individual words; tight leading; one witty sentence filling most of the canvas; small brand mark in a corner.

styles.name: Glassmorphism
styles.cues: frosted or reeded glass over colour and photos, blur and refraction, translucent 3D glass shapes, clean sans
styles.use: app UI, OS surfaces, product landing pages, campaign posters
styles.board: Four posters: a portrait behind fluted glass with big white type, a blurred figure through reeded glass with yellow type, a portrait on red seen through ribbed glass, clear 3D glass rings on white. Shows reeded and 3D glass rather than frosted UI panels.
styles.recipe: Subject or colour field seen through fluted or frosted glass, so it smears into vertical strips or soft blur; translucent glass panels or 3D glass shapes with bright edge highlights and soft shadows; one vivid background colour; crisp white or dark sans type sitting on top, untouched by the blur.

styles.name: Modular Typography
styles.cues: letters built from grid modules, pixel and stencil forms, monospaced dot type, black on grey or white, one vivid colour
styles.use: type-led posters, tech brands, identity systems
styles.board: Four posters: a phone launch in dot-matrix type with a parrot, huge modular block letters on a grey grid, blue and pink overlapping modular numerals, black modular letters for a tech magazine.
styles.recipe: Headline letters constructed from repeated grid modules (squares, quarter circles, bars) at very large size; black on light grey or white, or overprinted blue and pink; visible construction grid; small dot-matrix or monospace secondary type; tight rhythm, no imagery or one object.

styles.name: Neo-Brutalism
styles.cues: thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, flat bright fills, window-style cards, chunky sans, stickers and starbursts
styles.use: startup landing pages, creator sites, workshops, social
styles.board: Four designs: a channel promo in black-outlined windows with lilac type, a fintech poster with a retro computer face and thick outlines, a pink checkerboard music poster, a lavender workshop poster with black-outlined pill buttons.
styles.recipe: Flat bright fills (lilac, lime, pink, sky blue, yellow) with 2 to 3 px black outlines on every card and button, hard offset black shadows with no blur, window-style frames and pill buttons; chunky grotesk or rounded display type; starbursts and stickers as accents; light grid-paper ground.

styles.name: Expressive Type
styles.cues: warped, swollen or jittery display letters that act as the logo, black on white or one loud colour, no icon
styles.use: food and drink brands, streetwear, event names, merch
styles.board: Three wordmarks where the letters themselves are distorted: stretched, melted and wobbly black display lettering on white, cream and acid yellow.
styles.recipe: Wordmark only, no symbol: a custom display word whose letters are stretched, swollen or jittered so the shape itself carries the energy; solid black on one flat field (white, cream or one acid colour); tight letter spacing, letters touching; generous margin around a single word.

source.title: 10 logo design styles (reel)
source.credit: Luis Low (@mono.des1gns); logos by various designers

styles.name: Fun Chunky
styles.cues: heavy rounded bold display type, soft blobby counters, flat saturated fields, cheerful small line icon
styles.use: cafés, snacks, consumer apps, kids, community brands
styles.board: Three brand cards: chunky rounded yellow-on-blue, cream-on-cobalt with a cup line icon, and cream on forest green.
styles.recipe: One heavy rounded display word with soft bulbous terminals and small counters, set big on one flat saturated field (cobalt, forest green, sunflower); optional single-weight line icon above; tiny caps tagline underneath; two colours only, no gradients.

source.title: 10 logo design styles (reel)
source.credit: Luis Low (@mono.des1gns); logos by various designers

styles.name: Organic Curves
styles.cues: flowing hand-cut letters with leafy swashes, deep greens and botanical photo grounds, cream ink
styles.use: plant, food, wellness and outdoor brands
styles.board: Three marks in cream letters with curling, leaf-like strokes over dark green foliage and botanical photography.
styles.recipe: Cream or off-white custom lettering whose strokes curl and taper like stems and leaves, set over deep green foliage or a dark botanical photo; soft irregular baseline; one or two words; no hard geometry or outlines.

source.title: 10 logo design styles (reel)
source.credit: Luis Low (@mono.des1gns); logos by various designers

styles.name: Bubbly Maximalism
styles.cues: puffy inflated blob letters, thick outlines, red, cream and acid yellow, letters crammed into a sticker shape
styles.use: snacks, hot sauce, streetwear, music nights, stickers
styles.board: Three sticker logos with inflated, overlapping bubble letters in red, cream and black on acid yellow.
styles.recipe: Inflated bubble lettering, letters overlapping and squeezed into one rounded sticker silhouette, thick black or red outline, small white highlights; red, cream, black and acid yellow; crowded and bouncy, no straight lines.

source.title: 10 logo design styles (reel)
source.credit: Luis Low (@mono.des1gns); logos by various designers

styles.name: Retro Print
styles.cues: vintage badge and stamp lockups, slab and script type, worn ink and paper texture, 70s to 90s print colours
styles.use: food trucks, print shops, merch, posters, packaging
styles.board: Badge logos in red, navy and black-and-white stamp styles, plus a dark poster with a VHS tape and bold slab headline.
styles.recipe: Vintage print look: a badge, stamp or poster lockup with a bold slab or brush-script headline, small caps sublines and rules; worn ink with slight misregistration and paper grain; two or three flat inks (brick red, navy, cream, black).

source.title: 10 logo design styles (reel)
source.credit: Luis Low (@mono.des1gns); logos by various designers

styles.name: Handwritten
styles.cues: loose marker or brush handwriting as the hero, hand-drawn line marks, cream ink on a flat colour or black on cream
styles.use: food, indie brands, invitations, social posts
styles.board: A deep red poster with a chunky cream handwritten title, plus hand-drawn line logos (an eye, a circled name, a simple mark) on cream.
styles.recipe: Headline written by hand in a chunky marker or brush script, slightly uneven baseline and stroke weight; cream on a deep flat colour or black on cream; small handwritten notes and simple hand-drawn line marks; nothing typeset except tiny credits.

styles.name: Editorial
styles.cues: magazine-cover layout, huge high-contrast serif masthead, black-and-white photo, small sidebar copy, one red accent
styles.use: magazines, campaigns, book and film launches, portfolios
styles.board: A magazine-style poster: a blindfolded classical statue in black and white under a giant serif masthead with one word in red.
styles.recipe: Magazine cover structure: an oversized high-contrast serif masthead across the top, one black-and-white hero photo, small grotesk cover lines in columns and a few hairline rules; off-white paper; a single red accent on one word.

styles.name: Swiss Design
styles.cues: International Typographic Style: flush-left grotesk in tight blocks, strict grid, one flat colour field, small numbers and rules
styles.use: posters, tech and culture brands, annual reports, landing pages
styles.board: A red poster with a black halftone image and a block of flush-left white grotesk text on a visible grid.
styles.recipe: Strict modular grid, flush-left neo-grotesk set in one tight block, big and small sizes only; one flat field colour (signal red, cobalt or black) with white type; small numbers, dates and hairline rules aligned to the grid; one cut-out or halftone image.

styles.name: Clay Render
styles.cues: soft matte clay 3D, rounded chunky forms, miniature storybook scenes, pastel and warm colours, soft studio light
styles.use: app illustrations, campaigns, kids, product explainers
styles.board: A clay-rendered Japanese street corner with blossoms under 'clay render' type, plus a poster of a woman among chunky matte clay plants on mint.
styles.recipe: Everything modelled in soft matte clay or plasticine: rounded chunky shapes, visible thumb-smoothed surfaces, slightly oversized props; warm pastel palette with one saturated colour; soft diffuse studio light, gentle ambient occlusion, shallow depth of field.

styles.name: Liquid Glass
styles.cues: iridescent pastel liquid and glass bubbles flowing around a figure or wordmark, wet highlights, pink, lilac and pearl
styles.use: beauty, fashion, music, tech launches
styles.board: A portrait wrapped in clear pastel liquid bubbles under melting glossy 'new liquid' lettering.
styles.recipe: Clear iridescent liquid and glass droplets flowing around the subject and through the type, pearl, lilac, baby pink and pale blue; strong wet specular highlights and caustics; soft white background; the title itself rendered as melting liquid glass.

styles.name: Liquid Chrome
styles.cues: molten mirror-chrome forms, floral or organic shapes, sky reflections, pale pastel ground
styles.use: tech, fashion, music covers, product launches
styles.board: A molten chrome flower bursting from a mirror frame against a pale sky.
styles.recipe: Molten mirror chrome shaped into one organic hero form (a flower, splash or ribbon), reflecting a soft pastel sky; pale clean background; razor-sharp highlights, no texture; minimal small type.

styles.name: Cutaway World
styles.cues: a floating island or building sliced open to show many tiny rooms, dense miniature detail, water and blossoms
styles.use: posters, game art, explainers, brand worlds
styles.board: A floating chunk of land cut open to show a multi-storey house of tiny rooms above turquoise water and blossom trees.
styles.recipe: A floating island or building shown as a cutaway cross-section, revealing many tiny lit rooms, stairs and people; dense miniature detail, tilt-shift look; blossom trees and water on top and below; warm interior light against a soft sky.

styles.name: Electro Biomorph
styles.cues: translucent glassy creature with glowing internal structure, iridescent energy wave, black ground, tech annotations
styles.use: tech launches, music art, sci-fi posters
styles.board: A translucent spider-like creature of glass and light walking on an iridescent wave, on black with small data labels.
styles.recipe: A creature built from clear glass and light, internal glowing filaments visible, standing on an iridescent energy wave; pure black background; violet, blue and white light only; tiny technical labels and data columns around the edges.

styles.name: Stitch and Wire
styles.cues: handmade diorama: paper and felt pieces, cotton clouds and a sun hung on wire, soft photographed set
styles.use: storybook campaigns, kids, stationery, social
styles.board: A handmade diorama of a cottage and blossom tree on a rock, with cotton clouds and a felt sun hanging on wires.
styles.recipe: A small handmade set photographed like a stop-motion stage: paper, felt and clay pieces, cotton-wool clouds and a felt sun visibly hung on thin wires; warm soft light, shallow depth of field, cream backdrop.

styles.name: Minimalism
styles.cues: one small subject on a large empty ground, one accent colour, tiny type, simple geometric marks
styles.use: posters, brands, landing pages, product launches
styles.board: A cream poster with one small figure reading a red paper on a chair, plus minimal geometric logo marks in green, blue and grey.
styles.recipe: One small subject placed off-centre on a large empty warm or cool neutral ground; a single accent colour used once; tiny sans caption in a corner; any mark reduced to one or two simple geometric shapes; at least 70% of the frame empty.

styles.name: Maximalism
styles.cues: dense collage of type, photos, stickers and patterns, every colour at full strength, giant stacked headline
styles.use: festivals, fashion drops, youth campaigns, social
styles.board: A poster crammed with cut-outs, flowers, eyes and stickers behind a giant stacked multicolour 'MAXIMALISM' headline.
styles.recipe: Fill every inch: a giant stacked multicolour headline over a dense collage of cut-out photos, flowers, eyes, stickers and patterns; saturated pink, yellow, blue and green clashing on purpose; small slogans scattered at angles; no empty space.

styles.name: Futuristic
styles.cues: sleek tech portrait, visor or goggles, monochrome grey with one signal red, clean wide grotesk, tiny data labels
styles.use: tech launches, events, fashion-tech, product posters
styles.board: A grey-and-red poster of a person in a futuristic visor beside clean white 'FUTURE VISION' type.
styles.recipe: One person or product in a sleek futuristic visor or object, photographed hard on a split field of graphite grey and signal red; clean wide grotesk headline in white; tiny technical labels in the corners; high contrast, no clutter.

styles.name: Flat Vector
styles.cues: flat vector portrait, crisp shapes with no outlines, limited muted palette, simple shading blocks
styles.use: editorial illustration, avatars, campaigns, social
styles.board: A flat vector portrait of a woman with a black bob and round sunglasses on dusty purple.
styles.recipe: Flat vector illustration: crisp filled shapes with no outlines, one or two shadow blocks per form, a limited palette of four to six muted colours (dusty purple, slate, black, skin tones) and one bright reflection; simple flat background.

styles.name: Cloud Cut
styles.cues: a sky photo sliced into tall rounded panels on white, clouds continuing across the gaps, small caption
styles.use: posters, brand campaigns, landing heroes
styles.board: A blue sky with clouds cut into five tall rounded strips on a white page.
styles.recipe: A blue sky full of soft clouds cut into four to six tall rounded-corner panels with white gaps between them on a white page, the clouds continuing across the cuts; one tiny caption below; nothing else.

styles.name: Spiritualism
styles.cues: serene upturned face in the sky, beams of light, moons and a staircase into clouds, sepia and gold, thin serif title
styles.use: wellness, music, retreats, book covers
styles.board: A giant serene face in the clouds with a beam of light, crescent moons and a stairway over water, under a thin serif title.
styles.recipe: A huge serene face with closed or upturned eyes dissolving into clouds, one vertical beam of light, moon phases across the top and a small stairway or figure for scale; sepia, cream and soft gold; a thin widely tracked serif title at the bottom.

styles.name: Asian Storefront
styles.cues: dense neon shop signs in Japanese and Chinese, crowded shelves and lanterns, red and yellow, maximal street detail
styles.use: food and retail brands, posters, social, game art
styles.board: A crowded Asian corner shop front covered in red and yellow signs, lanterns, packets and a small TV.
styles.recipe: A crowded East Asian corner shop front: stacked red, yellow and green signs with bold Japanese or Chinese characters, lanterns, packed shelves, vending machines and small screens; warm neon and fluorescent light; dense street detail filling the frame.

styles.name: Envelope Reveal
styles.cues: an open envelope spilling layered cards, stamps and photos, wax seal, pastel pink, scrapbook detail
styles.use: launch announcements, invitations, newsletters, gifting
styles.board: A pink envelope with a wax seal, overflowing with floral cards, stamps and notes under a 'paper joy' title card.
styles.recipe: A soft pink envelope with a wax seal, opened toward the viewer, with layered cards, stamps, photos and notes fanning out of it; pastel pink, cream and sage; flat-lay paper textures and gentle shadow; the main message printed on the front card.

styles.name: Gzhel
styles.cues: cobalt-blue painted porcelain flowers on white, applied to a statue or object, crisp white studio
styles.use: beauty, homeware, heritage campaigns, posters
styles.board: A white classical bust painted with cobalt Gzhel flowers, surrounded by blue peonies and dissolving into fragments.
styles.recipe: A white porcelain object or classical bust hand-painted with cobalt-blue Gzhel-style roses and leaves, real blue flowers around it; pure white studio ground; crisp light; blue and white only.

styles.name: Camera Interface
styles.cues: street photo overlaid with camera or CCTV HUD: face-detection boxes, timestamps, scene numbers, alert icons
styles.use: fashion, tech campaigns, social, music art
styles.board: A street photo of a woman with face-detection boxes, a zoomed inset, CCTV timestamp and warning icons.
styles.recipe: A candid street or fashion photo overlaid with a camera interface: blue face-detection boxes with labels, a zoomed inset of the face, CCTV-style timestamp and scene number in the corners, small warning and folder icons; thin blue and white UI lines.

styles.name: Early Web
styles.cues: stacked late-90s and 2000s software windows, grey bevelled buttons, media players and progress bars over photos
styles.use: music, fashion, creative studios, social
styles.board: A collage of old media-player and dialog windows, progress bars and pixel icons over black-and-white photos.
styles.recipe: A collage of overlapping 2000-era software windows (grey bevelled title bars, media players, progress bars, dialog boxes) layered over black-and-white photos; pixel icons and cursor arrows; one bright accent colour; slightly low-resolution screenshots.

styles.name: Fairy Tale
styles.cues: lush storybook illustration, roses and vines around an ornate key or title, deep teal, pink and gold
styles.use: book covers, packaging, invitations, fantasy campaigns
styles.board: A deep teal cover with an ornate gold key and 'The Secret Garden' lettering surrounded by roses and vines.
styles.recipe: Lush storybook illustration: an ornate gold key, mirror or door as the centre, framed by roses, peonies and curling vines; deep teal ground with pink and gold; decorative hand-lettered title woven into the vines; rich gouache texture.

styles.name: Cozy Embroidery
styles.cues: a scene stitched in cross-stitch and embroidery on linen, cottage and trees, folk border, warm muted thread colours
styles.use: seasonal campaigns, food, homeware, newsletters
styles.board: A cross-stitched cottage, trees and sun on beige linen, framed by a folk-pattern stitched border.
styles.recipe: The whole image rendered as embroidery and cross-stitch on beige linen: a cottage, trees and sun in visible thread stitches, a folk-pattern stitched border; warm muted thread colours (brick red, moss, mustard, cream); soft fabric texture and slight puckering.

styles.name: Scientism
styles.cues: technical diagram drawing in blue ink: circles, axes, measurement lines and hatching on white, almost no type
styles.use: tech and research brands, posters, editorial
styles.board: A blue-ink technical diagram of circles, axes and dense hatching on white.
styles.recipe: A scientific or technical drawing in one cobalt ink on white: concentric circles, axes, measurement ticks, construction lines and dense hatching around one simple form; lots of white space; tiny numeric labels only.
